sections.title: Tax on business income of Offshore Banking Units or International Financial Services Centre unit.
sections.text: Where the total income of an assessee includes income of the nature referred to in section 147(3), the aggregate of income-tax payable by the assessee shall be the aggregate of income-tax computed on the income specified in column B of the Table below at the rate specified in the corresponding entry in column C of the said Table:

table.title: TABLE

rows.column_B: Total income as reduced by income referred to in Sl. No. (1) Rates in force.]

table.linearized_text: Section (218): Where the total income of an assessee includes income of the nature referred to in section 147(3), the aggregate of income-tax payable by the assessee shall be the aggregate of income-tax computed on the income specified in column B of the Table below at the rate specified in the corresponding entry in column C of the said Table: Table items: Item 1 - Nature of sum: Income referred to in section 147(3) 15%. Item 2 - Nature of sum: Total income as reduced by income referred to in Sl. No. (1) Rates in force.].
